meta.title: Knowledge Graph — Summit Supply Co.
how_to_read: relationships: every foreign key, with the exact join condition and what the link means.
join_paths['A->B']: every way to join A to B (up to 3 hops), shortest first. More than one path means the question must decide which relationship it means.
metrics: validated SQL for each business KPI; reuse `expression` + `default_filters` inside a larger query, or `sql` as-is for the overall value.
glossary: business terms with a ready SQL condition over `applies_to` (alias included); `ambiguous` terms carry a default interpretation and alternatives.
value_index: normalised phrase → the exact stored value(s), e.g. 'california' → Customers.State = 'CA'.
term_index: normalised phrase → the table / column / metric / term it refers to.

conventions.rule: Dates are ISO-8601 TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD' with no time part. Compare them with string literals (OrderDate >= '2024-01-01'), bucket with strftime('%Y', col) / strftime('%Y-%m', col), and compute day differences with julianday(a) - julianday(b).
The data is a snapshot as of 2026-10-20. Resolve relative periods ("last month", "this year", "last 90 days") against '2026-10-20' — e.g. date('2026-10-20', '-90 days') — not date('now').
The fiscal year is the calendar year; quarters are calendar quarters (Q1 = Jan–Mar).
State columns (Customers.State, Employees.State, Orders.ShipState) hold 2-letter USPS codes such as 'CA' or 'NY', never full names. "California" must become 'CA'.

"Revenue" / "sales" means net revenue: SUM(OrderItems.Quantity * OrderItems.UnitPrice * (1 - OrderItems.Discount)) over orders whose Status is not 'Cancelled' or 'Returned', excluding shipping — unless the user explicitly asks to include those.
OrderItems.UnitPrice is the price charged at the time of sale; Products.UnitPrice is today's list price. Always use OrderItems.UnitPrice for sales figures.
Orders has no total column. An order's value is the sum of its lines (Quantity * UnitPrice * (1 - Discount)); add Orders.ShippingCost only when asked for the amount billed.
OrderItems.Discount is a fraction from 0 to 0.30 (0.10 = 10% off), not a percentage.
"Customers from X" filters Customers.State (where the customer lives). "Orders shipped to X" filters Orders.ShipState (delivery destination). About 10% of orders ship to a different state.

Customers link to Employees in two different ways: Customers.AccountManagerID is the customer's assigned account manager (business customers only); Orders.EmployeeID is the sales rep who booked a particular order (NULL for self-service online consumer orders). Pick the one the question means.
Current employees have Status IN ('Active', 'On Leave'). Former employees keep their row with Status 'Terminated' and a TerminationDate.
Some customers have never ordered and some products have never sold. Use LEFT JOIN when the question asks to include them, or NOT EXISTS / LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL to find them.
Products.IsDiscontinued is an INTEGER flag (1 = discontinued, 0 = still sold).

metrics.name: Net Revenue
metrics.description: Line value after discounts, excluding cancelled and returned orders and shipping.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.Discount)) AS value FROM OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
metrics.base_from: OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID

metrics.name: Gross Revenue
metrics.description: Line value before discounts, excluding cancelled and returned orders.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) AS value FROM OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
metrics.base_from: OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID

metrics.name: Discount Amount
metrics.description: Money given away through line discounts on non-cancelled, non-returned orders.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * oi.Discount) AS value FROM OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
metrics.base_from: OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID

metrics.name: Units Sold
metrics.description: Units on non-cancelled, non-returned orders.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity) AS value FROM OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
metrics.base_from: OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID

metrics.name: Order Count
metrics.description: Number of orders of any status. Exclude 'Cancelled' when the user says successful / valid orders.
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) AS value FROM Orders o

metrics.name: Average Order Value
metrics.description: Net revenue divided by the number of non-cancelled, non-returned orders.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.Discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) AS value FROM OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
metrics.base_from: OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID

metrics.name: Gross Profit
metrics.description: Net revenue minus product cost (current UnitCost) on non-cancelled, non-returned orders.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity * (oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.Discount) - p.UnitCost)) AS value FROM OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = oi.ProductID WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
metrics.base_from: OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = oi.ProductID

metrics.name: Gross Margin %
metrics.description: Gross profit as a percentage of net revenue.
metrics.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(oi.Quantity * (oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.Discount) - p.UnitCost)) / SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.Discount)) AS value FROM OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = oi.ProductID WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
metrics.expression: 100.0 * SUM(oi.Quantity * (oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.Discount) - p.UnitCost)) / SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.Discount))
metrics.base_from: OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = oi.ProductID

metrics.name: Cancellation Rate %
metrics.description: Share of all orders that were cancelled.
metrics.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM Orders o
metrics.expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)

metrics.name: Return Rate %
metrics.description: Share of delivered orders that were returned.
metrics.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status IN ('Delivered', 'Returned') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM Orders o
metrics.expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status IN ('Delivered', 'Returned') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.name: Average Days to Ship
metrics.description: Average days between order and shipment, over shipped orders.
metrics.sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(o.ShippedDate) - julianday(o.OrderDate)) AS value FROM Orders o WHERE o.ShippedDate IS NOT NULL

metrics.name: Average Days to Deliver
metrics.description: Average days between order and delivery, over delivered orders.
metrics.sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(o.DeliveredDate) - julianday(o.OrderDate)) AS value FROM Orders o WHERE o.DeliveredDate IS NOT NULL

metrics.name: Customer Lifetime Value
metrics.description: Net revenue per customer who has bought at least once.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.Discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerID) AS value FROM OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
metrics.base_from: OrderItems oi JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID

metrics.name: Outstanding Payments
metrics.description: Value billed (lines after discount plus shipping) on orders whose payment is still Pending.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(t.billed) AS value FROM ( SELECT o.OrderID, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.Discount)) + o.ShippingCost AS billed FROM Orders o JOIN OrderItems oi ON oi.OrderID = o.OrderID WHERE o.PaymentStatus = 'Pending' GROUP BY o.OrderID, o.ShippingCost) t

metrics.name: Repeat Customer Rate %
metrics.description: Share of buying customers with two or more non-cancelled orders.
metrics.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM ( SELECT o.CustomerID, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Orders o WHERE o.Status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY o.CustomerID) t

metrics.name: Headcount
metrics.description: Current employees (Active or On Leave).
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM Employees e WHERE e.Status IN ('Active', 'On Leave')

metrics.name: Average Salary
metrics.description: Average annual salary of current employees.
metrics.sql: SELECT AVG(e.Salary) AS value FROM Employees e WHERE e.Status IN ('Active', 'On Leave')

metrics.name: Total Payroll
metrics.description: Sum of annual salaries of current employees.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(e.Salary) AS value FROM Employees e WHERE e.Status IN ('Active', 'On Leave')

metrics.name: Attrition Rate %
metrics.description: Share of everyone ever employed who has left. Filter TerminationDate for a specific period.
metrics.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.Status = 'Terminated' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM Employees e
metrics.expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.Status = 'Terminated' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)

metrics.name: Average Tenure (years)
metrics.description: Average years since hire for current employees, as of the snapshot date.
metrics.sql: SELECT AVG((julianday('2026-10-20') - julianday(e.HireDate)) / 365.25) AS value FROM Employees e WHERE e.Status IN ('Active', 'On Leave')

metrics.name: Inventory Value
metrics.description: Units in stock times unit cost, for products still sold.
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(p.StockQuantity * p.UnitCost) AS value FROM Products p WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 0

glossary.definition: A customer with at least one non-cancelled order in the 12 months before the snapshot date.
glossary.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Orders o WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND o.Status <> 'Cancelled' AND o.OrderDate > date('2026-10-20', '-12 months'))

glossary.definition: A customer who has ordered before but not in the 12 months before the snapshot date.
glossary.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Orders o WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Orders o WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND o.OrderDate > date('2026-10-20', '-12 months'))

glossary.definition: A customer whose SignupDate falls in the period being asked about.
A customer with two or more non-cancelled orders.
glossary.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders o WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND o.Status <> 'Cancelled') >= 2

glossary.definition: Customers with no rows in Orders.
glossary.sql: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Orders o WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID)

glossary.definition: Small Business and Corporate customers.
Consumer customers.
Customers ranked by a measure — by Net Revenue unless the user names another (order count, units).
Products ranked by Units Sold unless the user asks for revenue.
An order whose net line value is at least $1,000.
glossary.sql: (SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.Discount)) FROM OrderItems oi WHERE oi.OrderID = o.OrderID) >= 1000

glossary.definition: Orders not yet delivered, cancelled or returned.
An order shipped more than 3 days after it was placed.
A bank-transfer order still unpaid more than 45 days after it was placed.
glossary.sql: o.PaymentMethod = 'Bank Transfer' AND o.PaymentStatus = 'Pending' AND o.OrderDate < date('2026-10-20', '-45 days')

glossary.definition: Orders placed on Saturday or Sunday.
Employees with Status 'Active' or 'On Leave'.
An employee hired in the 90 days before the snapshot date (or in the period asked about).
An employee with at least one direct report (someone whose ManagerID points to them). Note that JobTitle containing 'Manager' is a different, narrower test.
glossary.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Employees r WHERE r.ManagerID = e.EmployeeID)

glossary.definition: A product still sold whose stock is at or below its reorder level.
A product with zero units in stock.
Products that appear on no order line.
glossary.sql: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OrderItems oi WHERE oi.ProductID = p.ProductID)
